head_coach.name: Pedro Leitão Brito (Bubista)
head_coach.play_style_summary: A balanced and highly structured style built on defensive compactness, a deep compact block, and quick transitions. Bubista's side relies heavily on rapid direct counter-attacks and wing exploitation, focusing on tactical discipline and team unity over high possession.

key_players.name: Logan Costa
key_players.performance_stats: Widely regarded as the nation's premier defender. Costa is known for his elite technical composure, physical dominance, and aerial ability, registering over 85% passing accuracy. He recently completed a lengthy rehab program to return to competitive play.

key_players.name: Dailon Livramento
key_players.performance_stats: Cape Verde's primary source of goals in qualifiers, netting 4 key goals. During his club campaign with Casa Pia, he proved highly active, winning 59 duels, creating 10 chances, and logging 22 shots with 32% on target.

key_players.name: Jovane Cabral
key_players.performance_stats: A creative force who registered 1,678 minutes of domestic play with Estrela Amadora. Cabral maintained a 79.2% passing accuracy, created 20 chances, won 136 duels, and successfully converted 7 goals in Liga Portugal.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Selected for the final tournament roster but remains a significant fitness gamble and precaution after recovering from a complete ACL rupture sustained in July 2025.
Sidelined from recent competitive call-ups and match squads due to an unresolved, unknown injury.
